notes.title: Day one patch
notes.notes:
As we released our first public version of Lux mina yesterday, we would like to introduce our day-one-patch! This includes the option to change your language, so you can play the game with a Spanish, French, Russian, German and Norwegian translation. As well, we optimized Lux mina furthermore for an improved experience and fixed minor bugs. 

[b]We have it all listed for you:[/b]
Content:
[list]
[*] Localization
[*] Skills-Menu working properly
[*] Death screen fixed
[/list]
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Shoplock improved
[*] Bat hit box reworked
[*] Colliders fixed
[*] Multiple chunks fixed
[*] Correct player stats
[*] Enemy lock distance smaller
[/list]
Graphical Improvements:
[list]
[*] Video Player arrangement
[*] Exit door looking smoother
[/list]
UI:
[list]
[*] Rune UI showing correct names
[*] UI in game sizes matching screen size now
[/list]
Balancing:
[list]
[*] Enemy stats
[*] Enemy spawn rates
[/list]

Sadly, we had to reset the progress made. This is a one-time act and won't happen again - we wish you a lot of fun playing the game now! :)
Your JOIS Games Team!
